known_cutoff_publicity_caveats: Moonshot AI does not publish a training-data cutoff for Kimi K3; the structured cutoff remains unknown. Checked 2026-08-30 against the Hugging Face model card (https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K3), the vendor quickstart (https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/kimi-k3-quickstart), the models-overview API reference, and the launch blog (https://www.kimi.ai/blog/kimi-k3). None states one. The release date is not a cutoff and is not used as a proxy for one.

Kimi K3 was released 2026-07-17, after the Cycle 1 corpus decision window closed and after the corpus anchor of 2026-06-30. This entry is supplementary: it must never be substituted into the frozen Cycle 1 registry, and its rows publish as supplementary_post_anchor rather than official.

Execution settings mirror the frozen official successor registry wherever the provider allows it: controlled_docket_tool_only, max_output_tokens 128000, an explicit reasoning setting, and provider-default sampling. Kimi K3's own max_completion_tokens ceiling is 1,048,576, so the official 128000 parity cap is reachable and no provider-imposed deviation was required.

reasoning_effort 'high' matches the official successor registry's OpenAI reasoning_effort 'high'. Kimi K3 accepts only 'low', 'high' and 'max' and defaults to 'max' (source: https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K3 model card, checked 2026-08-30: 'Kimi K3 always has thinking enabled, and will return reasoning_content. Thinking effort is configured with the top-level reasoning_effort request field, which supports "low", "high", and "max" (default "max")'). Selecting 'high' deliberately overrides the model's own 'max' default DOWNWARD so the setting matches what the official four ran at; running Kimi at 'max' would give it a reasoning budget the official models did not have. The value is always sent explicitly, never left to the provider default.

DEVIATION -- served host is not the model vendor. Kimi K3 is served through DeepInfra at model id 'moonshotai/Kimi-K3', not through Moonshot's own API, because the owner asked for a US inference provider. Host API shape, pricing, quantization and usage accounting are DeepInfra's, not Moonshot's, and Moonshot's own documentation does not describe them.

DEVIATION -- no request-level version pinning exists. No US inference host offers a request-level snapshot for this model; every host's id floats to latest. Verified 2026-08-30 across Together AI, Fireworks AI, DeepInfra, Novita, Baseten and OpenRouter. DeepInfra was selected because it is the only one publishing machine-readable serving identity through a free unauthenticated endpoint, which supports drift DETECTION rather than a pin. At freeze time https://api.deepinfra.com/models/moonshotai/Kimi-K3 returned version 'rGFGeaND', quantization null, and max_tokens 1048576 (fetched directly 2026-08-30). Preflight must re-read that endpoint before dispatch and REFUSE if version or quantization has changed. This converts a silent substitution into a loud refusal; it is not, and must never be described as, a request-level pin.

Quantization risk is inherently low for this model, independently of the host. Kimi K3's released checkpoint is natively MXFP4: the model card states 'Quantization: MXFP4 weights / MXFP8 activations (quantization-aware training)' and 'Kimi K3 applies quantization-aware training from the SFT stage onward' (checked 2026-08-30). There is therefore no host precision choice to drift, which is consistent with DeepInfra reporting no quantization override. This is the reason Kimi K3 was the open-weight model carried forward and, for example, MiniMax M3 -- served at fp8 on DeepInfra and FP4 on Together -- would not have been.

UNVERIFIED PENDING PROBE -- reasoning-token accounting. As of 2026-08-30 DeepInfra's documentation contains no occurrence of completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens and no response example showing where reasoning tokens are counted; it states only that reasoning tokens count toward output-token billing. Neighbouring hosts do not settle it: Together documents this same model's reasoning tokens as INCLUDED in completion_tokens (its Kimi K3 example reads completion 133 of which thinking 111), while xAI documents its own as EXCLUDED and additive. The adapter therefore treats DeepInfra as unverified_conservative and ADDS any reported reasoning tokens, because under-reporting spend against this cycle's provider cap is the unrecoverable direction; response metadata records reasoning_token_accounting=unverified_conservative so a run on this shape cannot be mistaken for a verified one. The one-call shape probe must resolve this before any paid dispatch.

Kimi K3 returns its reasoning trace in a separate reasoning_content field rather than in message.content, and Together additionally documents that the field name varies by model on a shared host ('reasoning' versus 'reasoning_content'). The adapter reads message.content only and refuses an empty one, so reasoning text is never scored as the answer and an empty answer is never silently settled. Note also Together's warning that the reasoning trace and the answer share one completion budget, so a tight output cap can return empty content; the probe must confirm 128000 is ample.

Kimi K3's weights are open under a custom non-OSI 'Kimi K3 License', not MIT or Apache. It imposes obligations on Model-as-a-Service operators above USD 20 million in trailing-12-month revenue and display obligations above 100M MAU. Neither threshold is near this benchmark's use, and DeepInfra rather than this project is the serving operator. Recorded for completeness. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-K3/main/LICENSE, checked 2026-08-30.

DeepInfra allows 200 concurrent requests per model per account with no tier or deposit requirement (checked 2026-08-30). No long-context surcharge is published for this model on DeepInfra, so no long_context_surcharge is declared; the flat rate applies across the full context.
pricing_source: https://api.deepinfra.com/models/moonshotai/Kimi-K3 and https://deepinfra.com/moonshotai/Kimi-K3, USD 2.85/M input and USD 14.25/M output with no active discount, cached input USD 0.285/M. Fetched directly 2026-08-30. Note this is below the USD 3.00/15.00 charged for the same model by Together AI, Fireworks AI, Novita and Baseten on the same date.
release_timestamp_source: https://www.kimi.ai/blog/kimi-k3, publication date 2026-07-17. The same post states 'The full model weights will be released by July 27, 2026', and the GitHub API reports repository MoonshotAI/Kimi-K3 created_at 2026-07-27. The announcement date is used as the release timestamp; either date is comfortably after the 2026-06-30 corpus anchor, so the classification is unaffected by the choice. Checked 2026-08-30.
